hooks.name: Write journey entry on stop
hooks.description: When an agent session stops, prompt the agent to append an entry to KIRO_JOURNEY.md.

action.prompt: The session is ending. If this session is a spec task and other tasks in the same wave are still running or not yet started, do not write to KIRO_JOURNEY.md; write only after the whole wave has finished, following .kiro/steering/journey.md. Otherwise (ordinary chat sessions, or the last task of a finished wave), append an entry to KIRO_JOURNEY.md using the template in that file, following .kiro/steering/journey.md: list only Kiro features actually used, record failures and user corrections honestly, copy any shrunk property-test counterexample, seed and requirement in full, leave "Model / credits" blank, and update the running tally table. If this session made no changes and used no Kiro features (a pure question), skip the entry and say so.
